aboutText: For over 50 years, Patio Builders Melbourne has been crafting premium outdoor living spaces for homes across Keilor Park and Melbourne's north-west. As registered building practitioners, we manage the entire process, from initial design through to securing council approvals. Our deep local experience means we understand the specific needs and regulations for projects in Keilor Park and surrounding suburbs.
servicesText: We design and construct a wide range of outdoor structures, each customised for your home and lifestyle. Our services cover everything from initial concept to final council sign-off, ensuring a hassle-free experience for every Keilor Park client.
